page.content:
Battle cry of the Joe team in the Sunbow cartoon and toy ads.

How Yo Joe! connects

  • Series: G.I. Joe (Sunbow series) — The Sunbow series made Yo Joe! the team's on-screen battle cry.
  • Faction: G.I. Joe team — The Joe team deploys under the shout Yo Joe!

What is Yo Joe!?

Yo Joe! is the shout the team uses as they deploy, the audio trademark of A Real American Hero and the Sunbow open that still means G.I. Joe more than any single rank.

Key threads lead to G.I. Joe (Sunbow series) and G.I. Joe team.
